results.rationale: Consistency: The white background and two drawstring-bag identities remain, but the unrequested small bag is reduced and repositioned, and both bags have noticeably coarser, higher-contrast fabric and altered printed details. The right-hand bag remains substantially taller and wider than the left, so the requested size match is largely unfulfilled. Quality: Structure, cords, beads and shadows are coherent; slight blotchy, over-sharpened fabric texture is the main imperfection.

Consistency: Excluding the requested background, base, lighting, viewpoint and arrangement changes, the chocolate-coated product category remains, but a third cookie is added and the original fine parallel drizzle and surface details are visibly redesigned. Instruction: The edit supplies brown velvet, black slate, warm upper-left lighting and a central stack. There are three cookies, a visibly downward view of the slate, and garbled text spanning the upper edge; this is partial compliance.
